# Exploratory follow-up (09.11.2026, branch explore), chosen after the main results: the one deviation
# found after the runs (Codex audit, 08.11). Credit Default (SEX, EDUCATION, MARRIAGE), Auto MPG (origin)
# and Energy (X6 orientation, X8 glazing-area distribution) were run with number-coded categories as
# numeric columns; plan §4 one-hot encodes categorical features. Here the same rows, targets and outer
# folds (checked), with those columns one-hot encoded (src/dfx/datasets.py: ONEHOT). All 11 methods,
# seed 0, main settings: 3 x 11 x 5 = 165 tasks. The seed streams depend on the dataset name, so the
# per-dataset errors also differ by seed noise; compare against the main run's seed-to-seed spread.
#
# Bar, written down before running: recompute the six comparisons of plan Table 4 on seed 0 over the
# 32 datasets with these three swapped in. The deviation "matters" only if a median reduction changes
# sign or a Holm p crosses 0.05. The per-dataset changes are reported either way.
datasets = ["credit_default_onehot", "auto_mpg_onehot", "energy_onehot"]
methods = ["base", "random_xx", "target_xx", "residual_xx", "xp_mi", "nonlinear", "monotone", "combined", "rf",
           "rf_target_xx", "lightgbm"]  # the 11 methods of plan Table 1
seeds = [0]
outer_folds = 5
